application.name: holoscan_camera_argus
application.description: Python graph using the native Argus operator to capture typed images and sensor metadata

changelog.0.1.0: SDK 5 Python graph validation and live capture through ArgusCaptureOp

requirements.python: CPython 3.12 or newer with matching Holoscan SDK 5 Python bindings and nanobind 3.0.1
requirements.linux: Compatible Jetson BSP with libargus, NvBufSurface, EGL and CUDA, including for graph validation

validate.description: Compile the Python Argus graph without opening a camera

capture.description: Capture host-memory images and 120 metadata samples from Argus camera 0, sensor mode 0
